name: Home Screen Sections Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs and saves hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home-section drafts using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries. It does not yet render the saved sections.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Sections Manager design and Abyss customization UI for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Fixes Jellyfin 10.11.11 translation corruption so current rows, ownership labels, selection, editing, inline naming, and all ten section-type flows render and work. Moves the customization save action outside Custom CSS, adds Jellyfin alert feedback with error details, preserves section settings, and applies the generated Abyss CSS. Test only; it does not yet render actual home-screen sections.
